title: Gel Moisturiser vs Cream Moisturiser: Which One Does Your Skin Need?
ex: Gel or cream? How the two moisturiser types differ, which suits your skin type and Indian season, and how to use both in one day and night routine.
rt: Gel vs Cream Moisturiser: Which to Choose | Mirc Glow
rd: Gel moisturiser vs cream moisturiser: how they differ, how to choose a face moisturiser for your skin type and season, and face vs body moisturiser explained.
quick: A gel moisturiser is mostly water and humectants, so it feels light and suits oily skin and humid weather. A cream adds oils and butters, so it feels richer and suits dry skin, winter and AC. Many people use gel in the day and cream at night.
facts: Gels mainly add water; creams add water and help hold it in.
Gel-creams sit in between and suit combination skin.
Face cream is one type of moisturiser.
Body lotions are often heavier and more fragranced than face products.
